_meta.purpose: Additive verified findings from the final integration session, merged into data/master.json by scripts/build_master.py. Nothing here replaces or re-guesses a value already on the site: every entry was read from the official document named in its url on 2026-11-16, and every field the document does not print is null.
_meta.how_to_use: Consumed by scripts/build_master.py. Do not hand-edit data/master.json.

county_room_tax.excerpt: Clark County Department of Business License, General Information Guide for Transient Lodging Establishments: licensed hotel/motel (HOT) accounts show '13.38%' as the transient lodging tax rate. The county's combined transient lodging tax return breaks the same burden into an 8.5% county component and a 4.5% county component.
county_room_tax.corroboration: The Cosmopolitan's official reservation terms state 'Nightly rates do not include 13.38% room tax' and the Venetian's hotel terms state 'Clark County Room Tax of 13.38%'.
county_room_tax.note: Previously the 13.38% figure rested only on hotel terms with no county source. This is the county's own document.

horseshoe_daily_times.note: Only the six start times are officially published. No buy-in, guarantee, structure or entry-rule document was located, so those fields stay blank.

south_point.slate: Four daily tournaments at 10:10 AM, 2:10 PM, 6:10 PM and 10:10 PM with $120 and $300 buy-ins; 30-table 24-hour room.
south_point.not_published: Which time carries which buy-in, guarantees, chips, level lengths and entry rules are not published on the page we could reach.
south_point.walk_rule: 9777 S Las Vegas Blvd is about 8 miles south of the Strip, so it cannot satisfy a 30-minute walk pairing with a Strip hotel.

aria.excerpt: ARIA's official poker page describes a 24-table room and directs players to its social account; it publishes no tournament schedule or structures.

westgate_resort_fee_conflict.conflict: The Westgate terms page states a '$49.99 +tax' nightly resort fee for Westgate Las Vegas; the property's resort-fee FAQ page says $49.99 in its body text but $36.99 in its embedded structured answer.

caesars_resort_fee_range.excerpt: Caesars corporate disclaimer: 'Room reservations are subject to a daily resort fee between $45-$50 plus applicable tax. Resort fees are waived for Diamond and Seven Stars.'

walking_check.why: No official hotel or poker-room page publishes a walking time between properties, and no routing service could be queried from the build environment. Every walk field stays blank and the 30-minute rule is recorded as unapplied rather than assumed.

attempts.result: The official booking calendar rendered every nightly price as '$XXX' to a non-browser fetch, so no dated rate could be read.

rate_log.method: Each attempt is appended with its dates, occupancy, what blocked it and a timestamp; a quote is only entered with check-in, check-out, occupancy, room type, nightly rate, resort fee, tax, parking, cancellation deadline and checkout total.

venetian_series_label.excerpt: The DeepStack overview page still labels the 'Current Series' as the WPT Fall Festival while the DSE IV event page and schedule PDF (Nov 16 - Dec 23, 2026) are live.

irregularities.item: No event has an affirmative single-entry document
irregularities.detail: All 30 structure sheets read across the Venetian, Wynn, Bellagio, Caesars and MGM either allow re-entry, sell chips, or say nothing about re-entry. No document states 'no re-entry, no add-on', so the site reports zero confirmed single-entry events.
irregularities.action: Ask each room for a written freezeout statement per event and log the reply with a date.

irregularities.item: Wynn publishes structures for only 13 of its ~46 series events
irregularities.detail: The WPT World Championship $10,400, the $400 Super Gold Million, the high rollers, the Ladies and Seniors championships and the close-out bounties have no published structure sheet, so their entry rules, chips and fee splits are blank.
irregularities.action: Ask the Wynn poker room whether those sheets exist.

irregularities.item: WPT schedule PDF contains internal date errors
irregularities.detail: A 'Dec. 18 Wednesday' block is actually Dec 16; $800 and $1,600 Day 2 rows conflict with the structures PDF; Super Gold Million jumps from Day 1A-D to 'Day 3' with no Day 2 row. Where the documents conflict the structures PDF was treated as authoritative.
irregularities.action: Ask the Wynn to confirm the corrected day-by-day schedule.

irregularities.item: MGM Grand tournament PDF is titled 'August' with no year
irregularities.detail: The weekly grid repeats consistently and matches the poker room page times (11:10 AM / 7:10 PM / 11:10 PM), but the document header is 'August Tournament Schedule' with no year, so the grid cannot be dated.
irregularities.action: Ask MGM Grand for a dated version of the PDF.

irregularities.item: Two official Westgate pages quote different resort fees
irregularities.detail: The terms page says $49.99 plus tax per night; the resort-fee FAQ says $49.99 in its body but $36.99 in its structured answer.
irregularities.action: Get a booking-cart total to settle which is charged.
